reviews.basis: Degenerate minima behavior is explicitly governed by RC-026 (Degenerate Minima Tiebreak Dynamics) and DSR-001 (Orientation Minimization Rule).
reviews.analysis: The counterexample (non-unique selection) is handled by permitting multi-branch retention (DTC-004, DTC-007) and secondary orientation-sensitive tie-breaking (DTC-002). Failure cases are preserved via RC002-CFM-001 through RC002-CFM-004. No global uniqueness is asserted, maintaining framework humility.
reviews.governance_note: Discharge does not promote RC-002 to proof_candidate; it only resolves one readiness gap for the current review_ready_with_gaps status.
